# Packages whose tests start a process that the test binary does not contain or that reads what go
# test cannot see change: go build or go run of another package, go list over patterns or other
# packages, node, bash or sh over files of the tree, a program named by the environment
# (govern's $GSM_AST_CHECKER). go test reuses an unchanged package's cached result, so CI runs
# these packages with -count=1 (.github/scripts/shards.sh run) and every other package from the
# test cache. One package directory per line, relative to the repository root.
# .github/scripts/check-uncached.sh (Lint) fails for a test file that starts a process and is in
# neither this list nor cache-sound-tests.txt, and for an entry here that starts no process.
